# gamelib-steamfiles synthetic fixtures

Tier 1 parity input (P75-E). Every file is hand-made with synthetic values only (appids 10/20/30,
SteamID64 `76561197960287930`, one value above 2^53 `76561198999999999`, 19-digit manifest gids).
No real user file is committed; real files are local-sweep only. The TS oracle capture (plan 03),
the Rust parsers (plans 04-10) and the golden test (plan 11) all run against these bytes.

Bytes are exact on every OS: `.gitattributes` marks `tests/fixtures/**` as `-text` and
`shortcuts/**` as `binary`, so CRLF, BOM and non-UTF-8 content are never normalised.

## Rules

- `${FIXTURES}` token: path values in `libraryfolders/` use the literal token `${FIXTURES}`. A test
  replaces it with the absolute fixtures directory in a temp copy. Never commit an absolute path.
- Once the TS oracle is deleted, a new case carries a Rust-verified expected value and a note
  naming its source of truth (a Steam client capture, or the Valve file spec), not the oracle.
- Binary `shortcuts/*.vdf` files are generated by
  `src/backend/storeManagers/steam/localFiles/__tests__/fixtures/buildShortcutsFixtures.ts`
  (run Jest with `GAMELIB_WRITE_STEAMFILES_FIXTURES=1` to rewrite them). `shortcuts/upstream/` is a
  verbatim copy of `src/backend/shortcuts/nonesteamgame/__tests__/test_data/`.

"Oracle" is `@node-steam/vdf` (text) or the hand-rolled `parseKv1` in `sharedRedists.ts`.
"Steam-correct" is what the Steam client itself would read.

## acf/

| Case              | File                    | What it pins                                                      | Oracle behaviour                                        | Steam-correct                     |
| ----------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| installed         | `installed.acf`         | StateFlags 4, InstalledDepots with `dlcappid`, UserConfig BetaKey | numeric strings coerced to numbers                      | values stay strings, ids exact    |
| downloading       | `downloading.acf`       | StateFlags 1026, Bytes\*/TargetBuildID/ScheduledAutoUpdate        | coerced to numbers                                      | integer fields parsed as integers |
| big-ids           | `big-ids.acf`           | LastOwner and manifest gids above 2^53                            | coerced to f64, low digits lost                         | exact u64 / string                |
| coercion          | `coercion.acf`          | name `1979`, buildid `0123`, `1e3`, `0x10`, `true`                | `1979` and `1e3` become numbers; `0123` loses leading 0 | all remain the literal string     |
| escapes           | `escapes.acf`           | `\"` and `\\` in name and installdir                              | no unescape: backslashes survive verbatim               | `\"` -> `"`, `\\` -> `\`          |
| duplicate-keys    | `duplicate-keys.acf`    | repeated scalar key, re-opened AppState block                     | later key wins, blocks merge                            | last scalar wins, blocks merge    |
| lowercase-keys    | `lowercase-keys.acf`    | lowercase `appstate`, `stateflags`, `installeddepots`             | `parseAcfTree` lowercases keys; raw parse is case-exact | key lookup is case-insensitive    |
| crlf              | `crlf.acf`              | CRLF line endings                                                 | parses                                                  | parses                            |
| bom               | `bom.acf`               | UTF-8 BOM prefix                                                  | BOM stays in the first token, root key not found        | BOM skipped                       |
| comments-unquoted | `comments-unquoted.acf` | `//` comments and unquoted tokens                                 | unquoted tokens matched by regex; comments skipped      | same                              |
| non-utf8          | `non-utf8.acf`          | byte `0xE9` inside name                                           | replacement char after UTF-8 decode                     | lossy decode, no panic            |
| unbalanced        | `unbalanced.acf`        | an extra closing brace                                            | throws or truncates                                     | error result, no panic            |
| truncated         | `truncated.acf`         | EOF inside a nested block                                         | throws                                                  | error result, no panic            |
| empty             | `empty.acf`             | 0 bytes                                                           | empty object                                            | empty / not-an-AppState result    |
| no-appstate       | `no-appstate.acf`       | root key is not AppState                                          | parses, caller finds no AppState                        | not-an-AppState result            |

## libraryfolders/

| Case          | File                | What it pins                                                          | Oracle behaviour                                   | Steam-correct                      |
| ------------- | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| modern        | `modern.vdf`        | numeric children with `path` maps, `apps` sizes, one missing path     | `getSteamLibraries` keeps existing paths only      | same set of existing library roots |
| windows-paths | `windows-paths.vdf` | `C:\\Games\\SteamLibrary` escaped backslashes                         | oracle leaves `\\` doubled                         | decoded to single backslash        |
| legacy        | `legacy.vdf`        | pre-2021: `TimeNextStatsReport`, `ContentStatsID`, string path values | non-numeric keys skipped, numeric values are paths | same                               |
| malformed     | `malformed.vdf`     | truncated file                                                        | throws                                             | error result, no panic             |

## registry/

| Case        | File              | What it pins                                      | Oracle behaviour            | Steam-correct          |
| ----------- | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| running     | `running.vdf`     | `Registry/HKCU/Software/Valve/Steam/RunningAppID` | numeric 1245620             | running app 1245620    |
| not-running | `not-running.vdf` | `RunningAppID` `"0"`                              | 0 treated as not running    | not running            |
| missing-key | `missing-key.vdf` | no RunningAppID                                   | undefined                   | not running            |
| lowercase   | `lowercase.vdf`   | key spelled `runningappid`                        | case-exact lookup misses it | case-insensitive match |

## valve/ (Valve client manifest, D-05 guards)

| Case            | File                  | What it pins                               | Oracle behaviour            | Steam-correct  |
| --------------- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | --------------------------- | -------------- |
| good            | `good.vdf`            | win64 > bins_win64 file/sha2/size, version | `ok`                        | same           |
| forbidden-proto | `forbidden-proto.vdf` | a `"__proto__"` block                      | `forbidden key __proto__`   | rejected       |
| no-win64        | `no-win64.vdf`        | no win64 root                              | `no win64 root`             | rejected       |
| no-bins         | `no-bins.vdf`         | no bins_win64                              | `no bins_win64 node`        | rejected       |
| bad-file        | `bad-file.vdf`        | file not `bins_win64.zip.<40 hex>`         | `bad bins_win64 file`       | rejected       |
| bad-sha         | `bad-sha.vdf`         | sha2 not 64 hex                            | `bad bins_win64 sha2`       | rejected       |
| size-as-string  | `size-as-string.vdf`  | size `0000000042` (leading zeros)          | coerced then accepted as 42 | accepted as 42 |
| size-too-big    | `size-too-big.vdf`    | size above 200 MiB                         | `bad bins_win64 size`       | rejected       |
| version-number  | `version-number.vdf`  | unquoted numeric version                   | accepted                    | accepted       |

## installscript/

| Case             | File                   | What it pins                                        | Oracle behaviour                                | Steam-correct           |
| ---------------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| dotnet-duplicate | `dotnet-duplicate.vdf` | two `"4.8"` entries, the second is the real one     | `parseKv1` keeps both in order; vdf merges them | both kept in file order |
| conditionals     | `conditionals.vdf`     | `[$WIN32]` after a value and after a key before `{` | skipped, not evaluated                          | skipped, not evaluated  |
| escapes          | `escapes.vdf`          | `\\` in Process paths, `\"` in a command            | `parseKv1` decodes `\\` and `\"`                | same                    |
| no-run-process   | `no-run-process.vdf`   | no Run Process block                                | empty result                                    | empty result            |
| malformed        | `malformed.vdf`        | unterminated string                                 | throws                                          | error result, no panic  |

## scan/ (multi-library steamapps tree)

| Case        | File                                 | What it pins                     | Oracle behaviour      | Steam-correct         |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------- | --------------------- | --------------------- |
| installed   | `lib1/steamapps/appmanifest_10.acf`  | installed app                    | listed                | listed                |
| downloading | `lib1/steamapps/appmanifest_20.acf`  | StateFlags 1026                  | listed, not installed | listed, not installed |
| corrupt     | `lib1/steamapps/appmanifest_30.acf`  | unterminated string              | skipped               | skipped               |
| non-numeric | `lib1/steamapps/appmanifest_abc.acf` | appid `abc`                      | skipped               | skipped               |
| notes       | `lib1/steamapps/notes.txt`           | non-manifest file is ignored     | ignored               | ignored               |
| common      | `lib1/steamapps/common/`             | empty dir kept by `.gitkeep`     | ignored               | ignored               |
| second lib  | `lib2/steamapps/appmanifest_40.acf`  | app in a second library          | listed                | listed                |
| duplicate   | `lib2/steamapps/appmanifest_10.acf`  | same appid, different installdir | first directory wins  | first directory wins  |

## shortcuts/

Binary KV; see `shortcuts/` and the builder named above. Cases: `empty`, `one-entry` (GameLib field
order), `tags`, `two-entries`, `sparse-indexes` (keys 0 and 2), `lexical-order` (0,1,10,2 in file
order), `unknown-type` (0x07 uint64 and 0x03 float32 fields), `trailing-bytes`, `truncated`,
`non-utf8`, `negative-appid` (int32 high bit set), plus the 7 `upstream/` files.

## After the oracle (plan 27)

The TS oracle modules, the TS-equals-golden Jest test and the local parity sweep are deleted
(delete gate met, 75-PARITY.md). What stays is the permanent Tier 1 parity:

- `expected.json` is frozen: the captured oracle values are never edited or regenerated.
- A new case is hand-written with a Rust-verified value and a note naming its source of truth
  (Steam's own file or behaviour), never "the old TS did this".
- The replay tests keep asserting TS-wrapper(Rust) equals `expected.json`, or the `overrides/*.json`
  entry with its `divergenceNote`. `rust-results.json` is the committed Rust output they replay.
- The cargo golden test (`tests/golden.rs`) keeps the Rust side honest against the same files.
